picks.title: Dell Latitude 7420 Gen11 i5-1145G7 16GB 1kg
picks.why: Best spec-per-baht in the entire pool: Gen 11 CPU (2 gens newer than most picks), 16GB, ultralight premium chassis. Business-class battery.

picks.title: Dell Latitude 5490 i7-8650U 16GB 480GB SSD
picks.why: Same CPU+RAM as the ฿4,900 listing but with double storage. Pay the ฿2,690 premium if you want room for media.

picks.title: Lenovo ThinkBook 14 G2 ITL i5 Gen11 24GB 512GB+1TB
picks.why: Most RAM in the pool (24GB). Gen 11 CPU. Dual storage.
picks.risk: ThinkBook is lighter-duty than ThinkPad — plastic chassis

picks.title: Dell Latitude 3500 i7 16GB 512GB 15.6"
picks.why: Biggest screen + 16GB + i7 + 512GB. Winner if screen size is your top priority.

picks.title: Dell Latitude 5490 i7-8650U 16GB 256GB
picks.why: Best pure-value play. 39% below Kaidee warranty shop (฿8,000). Same chip as #2 but half the SSD.
picks.risk: no warranty at this price — inspect at pickup

picks.title: Lenovo ThinkPad T490 i7-10510U 16GB 512GB
picks.why: ThinkPad T-series build quality + i7 + 16GB + 512GB. Rock-solid daily driver.

picks.title: Dell Latitude 5420 i5-1145G7 Gen11 16GB 512GB
picks.why: Gen 11 + 16GB + 512GB Latitude — slightly pricier than 7420 for slightly bigger chassis.

picks.title: Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Gen1 i5-10210U 16GB FHD IPS
picks.why: Modern T14 chassis + 16GB + FHD IPS panel.

picks.title: MacBook Air 13" 2019 i5 16GB 256GB
picks.why: Only MacBook with 16GB in budget. Intel (not M1) so battery is ~8–10h not 15h+.
picks.risk: 2019 battery likely mid-life; verify cycle count

picks.title: Dell Inspiron 13 5310 i5-11320H 16GB 256GB
picks.why: Newest and hottest CPU of the bunch; 16:10 FHD+ screen aspect ratio. Small at 13.3".

picks.title: HP 15s-fq1012tu 15.6" FHD i5-gen10
picks.why: Big FHD + modern CPU if you want ≥15" and don't need 16GB.
picks.risk: consumer-grade build, weaker battery vs Latitude/ThinkPad

picks.title: Lenovo ThinkPad X13 Gen1 Ryzen 5 Pro 4650U 13.3" FHD IPS
picks.why: Business ultrabook at consumer price. AMD 4650U ≈ i5-1135G7 perf.

picks.title: HP 15-da2900TX i7-8550U 24GB 15.6"
picks.why: Biggest screen + 24GB RAM combo. Older CPU though.

picks.title: Lenovo L380 Yoga 16GB 256GB 13.3" 2-in-1
picks.risk: seller said 'read before buying' = disclosed defect — verify what

picks.title: 16" laptop Celeron N5095 16GB 128GB
picks.why: Biggest screen + 16GB + cheapest. Fine for pure thin-client (browser + RDP).
picks.risk: Celeron = slow for anything beyond browser

picks.title: ⚠️ MacBook Air M1 2020 @ ฿7,000
picks.risk: 50% under Mac2Hand floor (฿12k). HIGH fraud probability — activation-locked/broken/stolen. Demand serial + video demo + pickup-payment only.
